id.description: Overrides the generated id. Use when two error texts share the same `match`.

match.description:
Narrows when the error text shows: a `ValidityState` key shows it only for that native failure,
`true` forces it visible, and omitted shows it whenever the field is invalid.

dirty.description:
Whether the field's value has been changed from its initial value.
Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.

disabled.description: Whether the field is disabled. Also inherited from a surrounding native `<fieldset disabled>`.

errors.description:
Errors from outside the field, such as a server response. They mark the field invalid
until the user changes the value, and show again when different errors are passed or the form is submitted.

ids.type: Partial<{ root: string; control: string; label: string; errorText: string; helperText: string }>
ids.description: The ids of the field parts.

invalid.description: Whether the field is invalid, regardless of computed validity.

target.description: The item whose control the field tracks, for fields composed of multiple controls.

touched.description:
Whether the field has been touched.
Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.

validate.description:
Custom validation, run against the value and the native validity snapshot.
May return a promise; a newer validation run supersedes an in-flight one.
